column3: SELECT counter.sequence AS head, entry.* FROM (SELECT sequence FROM "wow_log__transfer__partition" WHERE partition = $1) AS counter LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 0 AS branch, sequence, tenant_id, aggregate_id, version, command_id, request_id, command_type, commit_time, events, owner_id, space_id, correlation_id, causation_id, headers, operator_id, operator_tenant_id, operator_cross_scope, transport FROM "wow_log__transfer__account" WHERE partition = $2 AND sequence > $3 ORDER BY sequence LIMIT $4)) AS merged ORDER BY sequence LIMIT $5) AS entry ON true ORDER BY entry.sequence
UPDATE wow_lease SET expires_at = $1 WHERE subscription_group = $2 AND partition = $3 AND owner = $4 AND expires_at > $5 RETURNING subscription_group, partition, owner, epoch, expires_at
SELECT subscription_group, node, address, expires_at FROM wow_lease_member WHERE subscription_group = $1 AND expires_at > $2 ORDER BY node COLLATE "C"
SELECT * FROM "wow_failure_ledger" WHERE service = $1 AND subscription = $2 ORDER BY context, aggregate_name, tenant_id, aggregate_id LIMIT $3

SELECT owner_aggregate, owner_tenant_id, owner_id, key, timer_id, version, partition, rule, slot, due_at, target_context, target_aggregate, target_tenant_id, target_id, command_type, body, correlation_id, causation_id, headers, status, attempts, outcome, operator, scope, slot_due_at, skipped FROM "wow_timer__transfer" WHERE partition = ANY($1) AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FIRING') AND due_at <= $2 ORDER BY due_at, timer_id LIMIT $3
SELECT subscription_group, partition, owner, epoch, expires_at FROM wow_lease WHERE subscription_group = $1 AND expires_at > $2 ORDER BY partition

INSERT INTO wow_lease_member (subscription_group, node, address, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (subscription_group, node) DO UPDATE SET address = excluded.address, expires_at = excluded.expires_at
SELECT revision, rebuilding, backfilled FROM wow_snapshot_table WHERE structure = $1
select xact_commit from pg_stat_database where datname = $1
